title: Vesper and the Machine
author: Rosalind Lockridge
blurb: Gideon Thornbury, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
